title: Container Bookings: containers on which carrier roll compensation is paid
content:
## Rule
Carrier roll compensation on a Container Bookings booking is paid only on the containers the line was going to carry. Containers covered by the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance that the line has rejected were never going to sail, so the chargeable containers are the booking's container count less the container count of that rejected acceptance, never below zero, and nothing is subtracted when the booking has no rejected acceptance. A booking on which more than one dangerous-goods acceptance has been rejected falls outside the roll compensation rules, because its chargeable containers are not defined by them.

The rejected status and its container count are taken from the dangerous-goods acceptance record of the booking.

## Cases (hypothetical counts)
| Booking containers | Rejected acceptance | Containers compensated on |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | none | 9 |
| 9 | one, covering 2 | 7 |
| 9 | one, covering 11 | 0 |
| 9 | two rejected acceptances | not defined by these rules |

*All figures are hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*
